content.bridge_context: Understanding the most basic units of society: our family and the community we live in.

units.title: What is a Family?
units.explanation: A group of people related by blood or marriage, living together and supporting each other.
units.dual_language_instruction: Who are the members of your family? / आपके परिवार में कौन-कौन सदस्य हैं?

units.title: Living in a Community
units.explanation: A group of people who share a common environment and interact with each other.
units.dual_language_instruction: Name one neighbor who helps you. / अपने किसी एक पड़ोसी का नाम बताएं जो आपकी मदद करता है।
